summary: Very steep narrow lane with houses 7-10 m from the kerb.
reasons: Narrow lane, little room to pull off

best_section.where: South side of the steep link at its upper end

drivers.seclusion: Houses on the same side 7-10 m from the kerb for most of the stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with kerb-to-garden edges; no pull-off beside the lane.
drivers.convention: A few cars park at the top end; none seen on the steep part.

sun_shade: Part shaded by garden trees; heavy bush shade to the east.
